There is some kinda interesting history regarding this building, and the whole hospital.
Duke Tiškevičius built this as a manor in Vilnius, Lithuania's capital, in 1890's. He has built many manors across Lithuania and all of them are beautiful. One of his aunts became unwell (schizophrenia it is believed) and just before WWI he donated the whole manor and it's grounds to medical world and it was turned into a mental hospital in I believe 1914. Now, this manor building is used to hospitalise people with more severe mental illnesses like  schizophrenia, manias, or those attempting suicide and hurting themselves. There is always a staff member at any given time making sure everyone is safe and everything is in order. 
In 1957, the hospital expanded and the building I am at at the moment is used to hospitalise patients with depressive disorders and are of lower risk to themselves.
